speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Your hands are blue to the knuckles, Master Shakespeare. Was there no fire in that yard?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not where we stood, mistress. The plot was on the nail, and the sun does not clear the stable roof in February.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Hot pottage, sir, and the crust from the end of the loaf.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thank you, Alse. That will do before two.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Two of the clock again. You were out all morning, and you are going out again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The morning was the new comedy, with nobody paying at the gate. The afternoon is King Richard. I am in it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then button the doublet when you come off. I had enough of a January chest to last me till the warm weather.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I put the muffler in your hand, sir? It was on the peg.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Put it in my hand. And here is threepence for the board.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence, and it is entered. Do not call a bowl a kindness.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. I am gone after this, and back when the play is done.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I shall keep the door. The latch sticks, and it springs if you lift it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Leave the latch. Eat. You have a king to be at two, and this house is not going with you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The house stays. I am obliged to you both. The comedy's book is shut upstairs. This afternoon is the other roll.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Was the boy in the blue gown this morning, sir? I saw a colour go past the end of the lane, and I did not know it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He was. The watchet has come, and it is on him, and it is not paid for. Fifty shillings, still the mercer's. That is the whole of the news from the yard.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not bring the mercer to my table. A gown can be blue and still be a debt. I have heard enough of debts to know one when it sits down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is not sitting down. I said it so you would not think us clear because a boy looked fine in it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Did the little one sing?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He sang. He kept every note, and he lost the place he was to stand. Phillips put him back. That is a morning's work, and it is done.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then let it be done. The bowl is empty enough. Button the doublet. Two of the clock will not wait on a story about a note.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am buttoned. Threepence is the meal. The rest of the day is the other play, and I will tell it, if I tell it, when I am back.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I shall have the latch willing, sir, if willing is a thing a latch can be.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It cannot. Lift it. He knows the trick. Go on, Master Shakespeare, before the pot grows a sermon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No sermon. I had one on Sunday, and it was enough for the week. Two of the clock. I will be back when the king is done.
